# GPT Plays Civ

The goal of this project is to figure out how well language models can play Civilization when they have access to the same game actions and information as human players and can negotiate with each other.

We run the games in Unciv, an open-source remake of Civilization V. Models use a player API to move units, manage cities, choose research, and send messages and trade offers. Some civilizations use Uncivâs built-in AI, run on Prince difficulty as a reference.

Open a replay to switch civilizations, step through the game, and read recorded decision notes and diplomatic messages. The Statistics tab shows how score, population, and production changed over time.
